ong);reel.style.transition=ticks>27?'transform .16s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)':'transform .075s linear';reel.innerHTML=rows.map((r,i)=>slotItemHTML(r).replace('class="slotItem"','class="slotItem'+(i===4?' centerish':'')+'"')).join('');reel.style.transform='translateY(-229px)';if(ticks<max)setTimeout(tick,Math.min(190,55+ticks*4));else setTimeout(resolve,420)}tick()})}
async function refreshRerollButton(){let b=document.getElementById('rerollButton');if(!b)return;if(!SUPA_READY||!currentUser){b.style.display='none';return}let today=rollHistoryData().find(r=>r.day===localDayKey());if(!today){b.style.display='none';return}let {data,error}=await supa.rpc('daily_reroll_status');if(error){b.style.display='none';return}b.style.display='inline-flex';b.disabled=!data?.available;b.innerHTML=data?.used?'ROLL AGAIN USED TODAY':data?.balance<5000?'NEED 5,000 YZYMNY':'ROLL AGAIN? <span class="rerollCost">5,000 YZYMNY</span>'}

Longer ranges fill in automatically as daily history accumulates.</div>${x.kind==='album'?albumTrackList(x):''}<div class="detailActions"><a class="spotify" href="${esc(x.spotify)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">Open exact Spotify page ↗</a><button class="downloadCard" id="downloadCard">Download card ↓</button></div>`;drawer.classList.add('open');shade.classList.add('open');document.getElementById('downloadCard').onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();downloadCardImage(x)};document.querySelectorAll('.chartTabs button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{range=b.dataset.r;openDetail(x)});document.querySelectorAll('[data-albumsort]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{albumTrackSortMode=b.dataset.albumsort;openDetail(x)});drawChart(x)}
function closeD(){document.body.classList.remove('detailOpen');drawer.classList.remove('open');shade.classList.remove('open')}const closeBtn=document.getElementById('close'),shadeEl=document.getElementById('shade');closeBtn.addEventListener('click',closeD);shadeEl.addEventListener('click',closeD);document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeD()});document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));b.classList.add('active');kind=b.dataset.kind;render()});
